newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed to firm, shrug off Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed to firm, shrug off Greenspan.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed to higher on Thursday as London investors shrugged off Wednesday's remarks by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan on the state of the U.S. economy.

The FTSE 100 index was up 6.4 points at 4,335.7 points by 0848 GMT after losing 15 points on Wednesday in a knee-jerk reaction to Greenspan's warning that high U.S. equity prices may prove to be unsustainable.
"There were no real surprises in what Greenspan said," one dealer commented. "He is not a man who likes to be ignored and he has just reiterated what he said back in November."
